Name: herdr
Description: Monitor and control Herdr agents from Stream Deck: focus, approve, reject, interrupt, and send prompts.

com.github.yuntan.herdr.agent-slot.Name: Agent
com.github.yuntan.herdr.agent-slot.Tooltip: Show one Herdr agent's status and focus it when pressed.

com.github.yuntan.herdr.send-keys.Name: Send Keys
com.github.yuntan.herdr.send-keys.Tooltip: Send keys to an agent, including approve, reject, and interrupt.

com.github.yuntan.herdr.prompt.Name: Send Prompt
com.github.yuntan.herdr.prompt.Tooltip: Send a saved prompt to an agent.

com.github.yuntan.herdr.page-previous.Name: Previous Agent Page
com.github.yuntan.herdr.page-previous.Tooltip: Show the previous page of live Herdr agents.

com.github.yuntan.herdr.page-next.Name: Next Agent Page
com.github.yuntan.herdr.page-next.Tooltip: Tap for the next agent page; hold for the previous page.

com.github.yuntan.herdr.pane-split.Name: Split Pane
com.github.yuntan.herdr.pane-split.Tooltip: Tap to split right; hold to split down.

com.github.yuntan.herdr.pane-swap.Name: Swap Pane
com.github.yuntan.herdr.pane-swap.Tooltip: Tap to swap right; hold to swap down.

com.github.yuntan.herdr.pane-close.Name: Close Pane
com.github.yuntan.herdr.pane-close.Tooltip: Hold to close the focused pane.
